heading: Where your explanations differ

headings.settle: What would tell your explanations apart

empty: Once two of you have revealed different figures for the same card, they show here side by side, with what each does to the chances.

differences.label: per specialist
differences.status_text: With either figure, 'Add one specialist' is the option most likely to achieve 'At least 100 a week'; the chances move between them. The chance that 'Add one specialist' achieves 'At least 100 a week' is about 7% with Paul's figure and about 94% with Sam's figure.

settle.text: In this model's draws the result turns on 'per specialist': 'per specialist' would have to be above about 19.9 tickets/week/specialist (between 19.1 and 20.5 tickets/week/specialist). Sam's figure is on one side of that point and Paul's on the other, so a measured figure for 'per specialist' that lands clearly on one side would tell your explanations apart.

Evidence tells your figures apart only if it is more likely under one than the other: for example a recorded figure for 'per specialist' from a past period or a comparable case, checked against each of yours. Evidence that fits both does not settle it.

steps.text: Sam kept this as a disagreement: both figures stay as they are, and neither is taken as the model's.
Paul agreed to find out: until then both figures stay as they are.
